title: CloudIR-Bench: A Benchmark for Root Cause Analysis and Mitigation of Cloud Incidents
abstract: arXiv:2610.29185v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Root cause analysis (RCA) and mitigation prediction are essential for incident management, enabling the identification of underlying causes of failures and ensuring the reliability of complex cloud-based systems. With rising incident volume and system complexity, incident reports have become a valuable resource for these tasks. Recent studies have shown promising results using Large Language Models (LLMs) to predict root causes and mitigation actions from textual descriptions in incident reports. Despite these advances, further progress is hindered by the lack of publicly available datasets; existing work relies on private data, which limits transparency, reproducibility, and generalization. To address this gap, we introduce CloudIR-Bench, the first publicly available benchmark providing a dataset and evaluation framework for incident report-based RCA and mitigation prediction. Curated from incident reports across five leading cloud-base

translated_title: CloudIR-Bench：一个用于云事件根因分析与缓解的基准测试
translated_abstract: 根因分析（RCA）和缓解措施预测是事件管理的关键环节，能够识别故障的深层原因并确保复杂云系统的可靠性。随着事件数量和系统复杂性的不断上升，事件报告已成为完成这些任务的宝贵资源。最近的研究表明，使用大语言模型（LLM）从事件报告的文本描述中预测根因和缓解措施已取得了可喜的成果。尽管取得了这些进展，由于缺乏公开可用的数据集，进一步的进展受到阻碍；现有工作依赖于私有数据，这限制了透明度、可复现性和泛化能力。为填补这一空白，我们提出了 CloudIR-Bench，这是首个公开可用的基准测试，为基于事件报告的根因分析和缓解措施预测提供了数据集和评估框架。该数据集精选自五大领先云服务提供商的事件报告。
tldr: 本文提出了首个公开可用的基准测试 CloudIR-Bench，为基于事件报告的云事件根因分析与缓解措施预测提供数据集和评估框架，解决了以往依赖私有数据导致的可复现性和泛化性受限的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CloudIR-Bench, the first publicly available benchmark providing a dataset and evaluation framework for root cause analysis and mitigation prediction of cloud incidents based on incident reports, addressing the limitations of prior work that relied on private data.
